summary: Resolves a camera target name string a2 into a camera target pointer for the race commentary/camera director. Empty a2 returns 0. Compares a2 with sub_588410 (strcmp-like, returns 0 on equality) against the known names: "Player" (aPlayer_1) dispatches through ModeDispatchedSubsystemCall(&dword_5EA510); "Original" returns this + 0x8C; "Last" returns this + 0x90; "AnyTrackside" (aAnyTrackside) returns 0; a non-matching "None" (aNone) comparison falls through to TracksideCameraTargetLookup(*(this + 4), a2), otherwise the function returns 0.

local_names.this + 0x8C: camera target pointer returned for the Original name
local_names.this + 0x90: camera target pointer returned for the Last name

operations.description: Return 0 immediately when a2 is null.
When sub_588410(aPlayer_1, a2) returns 0 (a2 equals the Player string at 0x005BEB3C), return the result of ModeDispatchedSubsystemCall(&dword_5EA510).
When a2 equals the Original string (aOriginal at 0x005BEB30), return the camera target pointer at this + 0x8C.
When a2 equals the Last string (aLast at 0x005BEB28), return the camera target pointer at this + 0x90.
When a2 equals the AnyTrackside string (aAnyTrackside at 0x005BEB18), return 0.
When sub_588410(aNone, a2) returns 0 (a2 does NOT equal the None string at 0x005BEB10), return TracksideCameraTargetLookup(*(this + 4), a2); otherwise return 0.
Return the resolver result (0, a dispatched pointer, this + 0x8C, this + 0x90, or the TracksideCameraTargetLookup result).
